title: task view: deferred DEC-3 scope -- general --fields projection, --since/cursor note selection, per-note-by-digest retrieval, field-level omission metadata
description:
Deferred scope from QCLI-276 (Done), deliberately scoped out by DEC-3 rather than missed -- filed so the gap is a work queue item, not something living only in a closed task's finalSummary/unresolvedAtCompletion, which no --ready listing or sweep will ever surface.

QCLI-276 shipped quest task view --max-notes N (PR #84), the one piece DEC-3 (quest decision view DEC-3, agreed cross-repo with lore-cli 2026-09-14) scoped in for quest's side of the shared quest/lore projection-and-bound shape. QCLI-276's own acceptance criteria, filed 2026-09-13 before DEC-3 existed, named four more things DEC-3 explicitly declined to schedule yet:

1. Selecting a subset of top-level fields in task view's output (a general --fields projection, distinct from the notes-specific --max-notes).
2. Selecting implementationNotes by a cursor (--since <date> or similar) rather than only a tail count.
3. Retrieving a single implementationNote in full by a stable id/digest, independent of any bounded/paginated view -- for proof-evidence use where exact text matters.
4. Field-level omission metadata on a bounded/paginated response (which FIELDS were omitted, not just how many notes) -- notesOmitted (QCLI-276) covers the notes case only.

DEC-3's own text on why these waited: "a general --fields selector for the rest of the record may follow later if a concrete pain point appears; none exists today the way it does for notes." Same reasoning applies to the other three. This task exists so that when a concrete pain point DOES appear, there is a real record to pick up rather than a rediscovery from scratch (or a mistaken conclusion that the idea was rejected, which it was not -- it was deferred for lack of a driving need).

Not 0.7.0 by default -- the agreed DEC-3 shape is what ships this cycle. Argue for pulling a specific item in only against a real, named consumer need.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A concrete consumer need for at least one of the four deferred items is identified (or this task is explicitly declined/archived if none ever materializes) before design work starts -- do not design speculatively against DEC-3's own stated reason for deferring these

Whichever item(s) get a real need decide their own shape at that time, informed by (not bound to) DEC-3's existing semantics: projection additive/opt-in, a supplied bound enforced not advisory, omission always reported when active
The chosen shape is documented in the relevant quest instructions guide and, if it changes the shared quest/lore-cli contract, cross-linked with lore-cli the way DEC-3 was

plan: 1. Add --fields to task view, reusing fieldsValue + declaredFields (accept-set = task view manifest-advertised fields, ruling A). Project data to exactly the named keys (absent emitted as null, key present).
2. Human form: one TAB-separated line in the named order via renderTabSeparatedRows. NO fieldsOmitted (a projection is the caller selection, not a bound). Compose with --max-notes.
3. Update the manifest registry, help and goldens; add test/qcli291-task-view-fields.test.ts. Cite DEC-161.
4. Fold the QCLI-312 closure into this PR (check AC0-3 with #518 evidence and AC4 with where each notice went, then complete QCLI-312). Independent review-assignment; land on dev.
implementationNotes: Cross-referenced during a fleet-wide dedupe pass, 2026-09-17: related to but not a duplicate of QCLI-312 (task view --max-notes 0 rejection, plus task list having no projection at all). This tasks own deferred DEC-3 scope is specifically about task views general --fields projection and note-cursor/digest retrieval; QCLI-312 is a narrower, concretely-scoped, consumer-backed ask spanning both view and list. Left independent rather than merged.

QCLI-291 delivered in opum-ai/quest-cli#519. task view --fields reuses the QCLI-312 parser/validator; accept-set = task view manifest-advertised fields (ruling A); projection to exactly the named keys in caller order, named-but-absent emitted as null, human form one TAB-separated line; no fieldsOmitted; composes with --max-notes (cap first). Documented in command-help and the overview guide (AC3). Reviewed twice: round 1 approve (2 minor), round 2 approve after the boundary-projection fix. bun run check exit 0 on the reviewed head 327b1306. AC2 omission wording: notesOmitted is reported whenever the bound is supplied on the unprojected read; the bound-plus-projection collision is filed as QCLI-462, blocked on opum-doc, not left in this summary.
finalSummary: Delivered in opum-ai/quest-cli#519: task view --fields, the one projection mechanism (DEC-161, ruling A) extended from task list. Reuses the QCLI-312 parser; accept-set = task view manifest-advertised fields; data projected to exactly the named keys (absent -> null, key present), human form one TAB line, no fieldsOmitted, composes with --max-notes. Default read byte-unchanged. Documented in command-help and the overview guide. Reviewed twice (both approve); bun run check exit 0 on the reviewed head 327b1306. All three criteria checked. The bound-plus-projection omission collision the round-2 review found is filed as QCLI-462, blocked on opum-doc. QCLI-312 closed in this same PR.
